_about: Replayed from the 2D validation run new-game-20261005-002926-318384 (2026-10-07): the checkout a person restored to the accepted r1 content (HEAD 894b4b8, a person's commit), its public/content/units.json units in full, and game-design v1's units (fingerprint fields only) - the same 32 ids, every unit another one.

design_v1_units.objective: Drag the paddle under the ball and break all 10 bricks
Clear the two-row wall of 16 bricks before three balls are lost
Break the gold-cornered bricks, catch 2 multi-ball capsules and clear the garden
Break every brick - the clay ones crack on the first hit and break on the second
Break the two golden clay bricks to drop capsules, catch both, and clear the stairs
Hit the scarecrow's straw heart 6 times to empty its health bar; the bricks around it are only a shield
Hit the gift scarecrow's heart 3 times; each hit drops a capsule - catch all three
Defeat the Dusk Moth boss: break both wing shields, then hit its glowing body 10 times
Break every brick except the riveted steel bars, which never break
Break the breakable bricks while rows 2 and 4 slide and wrap at the walls
Break the gold clay bricks on the sliding shelves and catch 3 wide-paddle capsules
Catch the laser capsule and shoot out the clay wall
Thread the ball through the steel maze and break every brick behind its walls
Ride the conveyor: catch 4 capsules dropped by the sliding gold bricks
Clear the oil-vat steps with a wide paddle on your side
Defeat the Clockwork Press boss: break its steel-ringed shield, then hit its furnace core 14 times
Clear the frost wall before it creeps down to the red paddle line
Clear the frost wall in a cold snap: it creeps down every 6 seconds
Break the breakable bricks in the drifting ice rows while the wall creeps down
In the frozen pocket, catch 3 laser capsules; the wall is frozen and does not creep
Clear the wall before it creeps through the frozen steel gate
Break the avalanche slope while its rows slide and it creeps down
Clear the thawing wall at a calm pace
Defeat the Glacier Whale boss: break its plated back while the field creeps down, then hit its eye 18 times
Light the firecracker alley: break the red firecracker bricks so the blasts clear the cluster
Clear the wall while embers rain down - dodge them with the paddle
Trigger the powder keg: chain 3 firecrackers through the steel pen while embers fall
In the ash fall, catch 3 capsules while slow embers drift down
Break every brick in the three narrow ember lanes; embers fall straight down the lanes
Clear the burning ceiling before it creeps to the red line while embers fall
Clear the cooling vent steps at an easier pace
Defeat the Cinder Phoenix boss: break its feather shield through the embers and firecrackers, then hit its breast 22 times

units.objective: Break all 16 bricks - catch the capsule that drops
units.success: All 16 bricks are broken with at least one ball left; the clear card stamps one to three stars.
units.failure: The third ball falls past the paddle with bricks standing; the fail card counts the bricks left and Retry rebuilds the same board within 1 s.

units.objective: Break all 20 bricks - catch the wide capsule to reach the far corners
units.success: All 20 bricks are broken with a ball still in play, in any state of the paddle's width.
units.failure: The third ball passes the paddle with bricks left; the fail card shows how many and Retry restarts level 2.

units.objective: Break all 20 bricks - catch the laser capsule and shoot the rows
units.success: All 20 bricks are broken before the third ball is lost, with the laser's bolts counting toward the total.
units.failure: The last ball is lost with bricks standing, and the fail card keeps the bricks left lit behind it.

units.objective: Break all 21 bricks - the framed ones take two hits
units.success: All 21 bricks are broken, the three armored ones on their second hit, with a ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with armored or plain bricks left; the fail card shows the cracked ones still lit.

units.objective: Clear 20 bricks without losing a ball for three stars
units.success: All 20 bricks are broken with no ball lost inside the 24 s par time, which earns the third star.
units.failure: The third ball is lost; a clear that misses the par time or loses a ball still ends the level but earns fewer stars.

units.objective: Break all 23 bricks around the armored posts
units.success: All 23 bricks are broken, the two armored posts on their second hit, with a ball in play.
units.failure: The third ball falls with a post or bricks left; Retry rebuilds all 23 bricks and both posts uncracked.

units.objective: Break all 23 bricks - the armored fence hides the middle
units.success: All 23 bricks are broken, the five fence bricks on their second hit, with at least one ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost while rows behind the fence still stand; the fail card shows them lit behind the cracked fence.

units.objective: Wear down the boss: break the shell and hit the glowing core 8 times
units.success: The boss's health bar reaches zero from 8 core hits and the rest of the shell falls away.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with the boss still alive; the fail card shows the health bar where it stopped and Retry restores it to 8.

units.objective: Break all 27 bricks - steel bars never break, bounce off them
units.success: All 27 breakable bricks are broken with a ball in play, even though both steel bars still stand.
units.failure: The third ball passes the paddle with breakable bricks left; the fail card counts only breakable bricks.

units.objective: Break all 27 bricks while a row slides across the board
units.success: All 27 bricks are broken, the sliding row's six bricks included, with at least one ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks standing; the sliding row restarts from its start position on Retry.

units.objective: Break all 29 bricks - time the shot through the sliding steel row
units.success: All 29 breakable bricks are broken, the three in the sliding steel row included, with a ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks behind the sliding row still standing; the fail card shows them lit.

units.objective: Break all 29 bricks between two sliding rows
units.success: All 29 breakable bricks are broken, the laser capsule's brick included, with a ball still in play.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks left; the fail card shows which sliding row they sit behind.

units.objective: Clear 27 bricks without losing a ball - one slow row slides
units.success: All 27 bricks are broken with no ball lost inside the 27 s par time, which earns the third star.
units.failure: The third ball is lost; a clear that loses a ball or runs past 27 s still ends the level with fewer stars.

units.objective: Break all 30 bricks - armored corners and a sliding steel row
units.success: All 30 breakable bricks are broken, both armored corners on their second hit, with a ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with an armored corner or bricks left; the fail card shows the cracked corners.

units.objective: Break all 32 bricks through two sliding steel rows
units.success: All 32 breakable bricks are broken with at least one ball left, the lower six included.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks standing; a ball trapped above the steel rows counts as in play until it leaves.

units.objective: Wear down the boss: its sliding shell hides the core, hit it 10 times
units.success: The boss's health bar reaches zero from 10 core hits and the sliding shell falls away.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with the boss alive; the fail card shows the bar where it stopped and Retry restores it to 10.

units.objective: Break all 30 bricks before the field drops to the red line
units.success: All 30 bricks are broken before any brick's lower edge touches the danger line, with a ball still in play.
units.failure: A brick touches the red danger line, or the third ball is lost; the fail card says which and shows the field where it stopped.

units.objective: Clear 32 bricks and keep the lowest row off the red line
units.success: All 32 bricks are broken before the lowest brick's lower edge touches the danger line.
units.failure: The danger line is touched, or the third ball is lost; the fail card shows how many rows the field dropped.

units.objective: Break all 34 bricks - armored corners drop with the field
units.success: All 34 bricks are broken, both armored corners on their second hit, before the danger line is touched.
units.failure: A brick - cracked armored ones included - touches the danger line, or the third ball is lost.

units.objective: Break all 34 bricks while a steel row slides under the falling field
units.success: All 34 breakable bricks are broken before the sliding steel row, which cannot be broken, reaches the danger line.
units.failure: The steel row or any brick touches the danger line, or the third ball is lost.

units.objective: Clear 31 bricks without losing a ball as the field creeps down
units.success: All 31 bricks are broken with no ball lost inside the 30 s par time, which earns the third star.
units.failure: The third ball is lost or the danger line is touched; a clear that loses a ball or passes 30 s earns fewer stars.

units.objective: Break all 35 bricks - armored tops slow the clear as the field drops
units.success: All 35 bricks are broken, the five armored tops on their second hit, before the danger line is touched.
units.failure: The danger line is touched with the armored row or others standing, or the third ball is lost.

units.objective: Break all 35 bricks - steel bars block the lanes as the field falls
units.success: All 35 breakable bricks are broken with a ball in play before the danger line is touched.
units.failure: A brick or steel bar touches the danger line, or the third ball is lost; the fail card shows the field's last row count.

units.objective: Wear down the boss before its shell reaches the line: 12 core hits
units.success: The boss's health bar reaches zero from 12 core hits before any shell brick touches the danger line.
units.failure: A shell brick touches the danger line, or the third ball is lost; Retry restores the shell and the 12 health.

units.objective: Break all 34 bricks - the burst brick clears its neighbours
units.success: All 34 bricks are broken, the blast's eight neighbours included, with a ball still in play.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks left; the fail card counts the bricks the blast did not reach.

units.objective: Break all 36 bricks - chain the two burst bricks
units.success: All 36 bricks are broken, with the chained blasts' bricks counted as broken, and a ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks standing; Retry rebuilds both burst bricks.

units.objective: Break all 36 bricks - dodge or knock out the falling embers
units.success: All 36 bricks are broken with a ball in play, whether embers were dodged, knocked out or taken on the paddle.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks left; an ember on the paddle never fails a level by itself.

units.objective: Break all 36 bricks - bursts chain through armor while embers fall
units.success: All 36 bricks are broken, the five armored tops included, with at least one ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks left; the fail card shows which armored bricks the blasts only cracked.

units.objective: Clear 34 bricks without losing a ball - embers fall slowly
units.success: All 34 bricks are broken with no ball lost inside the 32 s par time, which earns the third star.
units.failure: The third ball is lost; a clear that loses a ball or passes 32 s still ends the level with fewer stars.

units.objective: Break all 38 bricks - bursts, armor and steel under falling embers
units.success: All 38 breakable bricks are broken, with the two armored corners on their second hit, and a ball left.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks left; embers on the paddle never fail the level by themselves.

units.objective: Break all 38 bricks - steel walls the lanes, embers drop every 4 s
units.success: All 38 breakable bricks are broken with a ball in play, the blast-cleared ones included.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with bricks left; the fail card shows which steel-walled rows still hold bricks.

units.objective: Wear down the furnace boss: 14 core hits through its burst shell
units.success: The boss's health bar reaches zero from 14 core hits and the shell falls away; the clear card shows the total stars out of 96.
units.failure: The third ball is lost with the boss alive; Retry restores the shell and the 14 health.
